story.iWant: a dynamic UI with domain/tag filters, pagination, and cognitive state visibility
story.soThat: I can steer Jarvis's memory and reasoning without touching backend config
story.tasks: - Task 1: Enhance Backend APIs for Metadata (AC4) - 3 subtasks - Task 2: Implement Filter Profiles (AC2) - 3 subtasks - Task 3: Active Filters Mini-Bar (AC3) - 3 subtasks - Task 4: Hover Tooltips for Descriptions (AC4) - 3 subtasks - Task 5: Planner Action Display (AC5) - 3 subtasks - Task 6: Trace Viewer Modal (AC6) - 4 subtasks - Task 7: Session Auto-Update (AC7) - 3 subtasks - Task 8: Ensure No Backend Mutations (AC8) - 3 subtasks

criterion.title: Filter Panels Enhanced
criterion.description: Domain and Tags panels support multi-select with checkboxes, search functionality filters checkbox lists in real-time, visible close button (×) on each panel, only one panel open at a time (auto-close others).
criterion.notes: Already completed: multi-select panels, search, close buttons. Story adds profiles and metadata.

criterion.title: Filter Profiles
criterion.description: User can save current filter combinations with custom names ("Hydrogen Ops", "GD Core", "Jarvis Architecture"), profiles stored in localStorage, quick-apply dropdown for saved profiles, edit/delete profile functionality.

criterion.title: Active Filters Display
criterion.description: Mini-bar showing currently active domains and tags, clear individual filter chips (× on each), "Clear All Filters" button removes all active filters, "Reset to Default" button restores saved default profile.

criterion.title: Domain & Tag Metadata
criterion.description: Backend returns domain descriptions via `/api/memory/domains` (enhanced), backend returns tag definitions via `/api/memory/tags` (enhanced), hover tooltips show descriptions for domains and tags, tooltip includes chunk count per domain/tag.
criterion.notes: Endpoints exist. Need to add description fields and chunk counts.

criterion.title: Planner Action Display
criterion.description: Display planner actions from `CognitiveTrace.trace_data` metadata, show actions like `INCREASE_DIVERSITY`, `TRIGGER_RESEARCH_EXPANSION` in UI, read-only display (no manual triggering), visual indicators for planner decisions.
criterion.notes: Depends on CognitiveTraceLog table from Story 4.5.6

criterion.title: Trace Viewer Modal
criterion.description: "View Full Trace" button on responses with traces, modal shows pretty-formatted trace tree (not raw JSON), expandable sections for: Query → Memory → Planner → Response, never shows raw prompts or LLM outputs (summaries only per 4.5.6).
criterion.notes: Requires new endpoint `/api/cognitive-traces/{trace_id}` and trace sanitization logic.

criterion.title: Session Auto-Update
criterion.description: UI polls for backend session changes every 30s, detects new domains/tags and refreshes lists, notifies user of new available filters, no page refresh required.

criterion.title: No Backend Config Mutation
criterion.description: All filter changes are session-level only, no permanent backend config modifications, settings stored in localStorage (client-side), filters affect retrieval stage only, never ingestion.
criterion.notes: Already enforced. Story reinforces this constraint.

artifact.title: JARVIS System Architecture
artifact.snippet: Memory system uses Qdrant (vectors) + PostgreSQL (full docs) for hybrid retrieval. Domain filtering and tag filtering are query-time operations via search_memory(domains=..., tags=...). No changes to core ingestion logic.

artifact.title: Epic 4.5 ARCHES Cognitive Stabilization
artifact.snippet: CognitiveTraceLog model stores full trace data in JSONB field. Trace ownership: ARCHES controller creates, finalizes, persists. UI must only read traces, never show raw prompts/outputs. Planner actions stored in trace_data.planner_actions array.

artifact.title: Story 4.5.7 - Jarvis Cognitive Console
artifact.snippet: Domain multi-select panel with search and checkboxes already implemented. Tags multi-select panel already implemented. Close buttons (×) on selector panels already implemented. `/api/memory/tags` endpoint returns 31 tags from Qdrant. Tag filtering with AND logic (must have all selected tags) already working.

artifact.reason: Main UI implementation. Contains domain/tags selector panels (lines 1158-1181), JavaScript for multi-select (lines 1469-1723), sendMessage function that passes tags to backend (line 2891). Need to add: filter profiles UI, active filters mini-bar, tooltips, planner action display, trace viewer modal, session polling.

Memory API endpoints for domains and tags. list_domains() returns domain list (lines 148-182). list_tags() scrolls Qdrant and returns tag list (lines 185-232). Need to enhance with descriptions and chunk counts.

Request/response models for memory APIs. MemorySearchRequest includes tags field (line 85-88). DomainListResponse and TagsListResponse need to be extended with metadata (descriptions, counts). Need to add: DomainMetadata, TagMetadata models.

CognitiveTraceLog ORM model with trace_data JSONB field. Contains planner actions, query mode, severity, and full trace. UI needs to read this for planner action display and trace viewer modal. Never expose raw prompts/outputs.

GenerativeDrive keyword-to-tag mapping dictionary. Contains 110+ tag definitions for GD project (hydrogen, solar, wind, hydro, etc.). Use this as base for tag descriptions dictionary in new tag_descriptions.py file.

Chat endpoint handles user queries and returns responses with metadata. May need to include trace_id in response metadata for trace viewer button linking. Verify that cognitive trace IDs are returned in chat responses.

constraints.constraint: UI state must be client-side only (localStorage). No backend persistence for filter settings. All filter operations affect retrieval queries only, never ingestion or document mutation.
Trace viewer must NEVER expose raw prompts, raw LLM completions, or sensitive user data. Only show summaries, metadata, and sanitized content per ARCHES Story 4.5.6 compliance.
Polling for domains/tags must not interfere with active user input. Updates must be non-disruptive. Preserve current filter selections when refreshing domain/tag lists.
Qdrant scroll for tag collection should use batch size 1000 and terminate early if possible. Chunk counts per domain should be cached or pre-computed to avoid slow queries on every domains API call.
Filter profiles must have unique names (validated client-side). Profile names cannot be empty. Active filters mini-bar should collapse/hide when no filters are active to save screen space.
All localStorage operations must be tested with mock storage in unit tests. API responses must be validated against Pydantic schemas to catch serialization issues early.

interface.name: /api/memory/domains (enhanced)
interface.notes: Enhance existing endpoint to return metadata objects instead of plain strings. Query Qdrant for chunk counts per domain using scroll + filter by primary_domain.

interface.name: /api/memory/tags (enhanced)
interface.notes: Enhance existing endpoint to return metadata objects. Load descriptions from tag_descriptions.py mapping. Count occurrences during Qdrant scroll to avoid second pass.

interface.name: /api/cognitive-traces/{trace_id} (NEW)
interface.notes: New endpoint to retrieve cognitive traces by ID. Must sanitize trace_data before returning: - Remove raw_prompt, raw_completion fields - Keep planner_actions, memory_summary, query_metadata - Include latency breakdown and stage timings

interface.name: Filter Profile localStorage API (client-side)
interface.notes: Client-side functions to manage filter profiles in localStorage under key 'jarvis_filter_profiles'. Profile format: {name, domains, tags, created}. Validate unique names.

tests.standards: Use pytest for all Python tests. Integration tests require Docker containers (Qdrant, PostgreSQL) running. UI tests use JavaScript unit testing with mock localStorage. E2E tests use browser automation (Playwright). All API responses must validate against Pydantic schemas. Test both success and error paths.
tests.locations: - tests/unit/ for Python unit tests - tests/integration/ for API integration tests - tests/e2e/ for end-to-end UI tests - Frontend tests inline in src/jarvis/api/app.py (JavaScript comments)

ideas.test: Test filter profile save/load/delete cycle with localStorage mock. Test profile name uniqueness validation. Test default profile restoration on page load.
Test active filters mini-bar shows correct chips for selected domains/tags. Test individual chip removal updates filter arrays. Test "Clear All" removes all filters and updates UI state.

Test /api/memory/domains returns DomainMetadata with descriptions and chunk_count. Test /api/memory/tags returns TagMetadata with descriptions and count. Test tooltip rendering with domain/tag descriptions in UI.
Test planner action extraction from CognitiveTraceLog.trace_data. Test planner action display in UI with correct icons/labels. Test read-only constraint (no manual triggering of planner actions).
Test /api/cognitive-traces/{trace_id} endpoint returns sanitized trace data. Test trace viewer modal opens/closes correctly. Test raw prompts and raw completions are NEVER exposed in trace viewer.
Test polling mechanism detects new domains/tags after ingestion. Test UI refreshes domain/tag lists without losing user selections. Test toast notification appears when new filters are detected.

Test that no API calls modify backend config (no PUT/PATCH to /api/config). Test that filters affect only query-time retrieval (verify by checking Qdrant data unchanged). Test that localStorage is the only persistence layer for UI settings.
